text.en:
During a slide, after sprinting for at least 1.5 seconds: 
Generate a 180° frontal shield that reflects damage and projectiles.

Increases Slide Distance by 33%.
text.ko:
적어도 1.5초 이상 질주한 뒤 슬라이드 할 시:
투사체를 반사하고 피해를 무력화하는 180도의 정면 방어막을 생성합니다.

슬라이드 거리를 33% 증가시킵니다.
text.zh-chs:
冲刺 1.5 秒后滑行：
产生一个 180° 的正面护盾，可以反弹伤害和弹道。

滑行距离增加33%。

text.en:
During a slide, after sprinting for at least 1.5 seconds: 
Projects a 180° frontal shield that reflects damage and projectiles for 0.45 seconds.

Passively Increases Slide Distance by 33%.

text.en:
Upon sliding after sprinting for at least 1.5 seconds with your Class Ability fully charged: 
Projects a 180° frontal shield that reflects all incoming projectiles for 0.45 seconds.

After shield deactivation, Class Ability energy is consumed proportionally to the damage reflected.
